mapper.select: SELECT db.*, u.real_name AS manager_name FROM dorm_building db LEFT JOIN user u ON db.manager_id = u.user_id ORDER BY db.code
SELECT db.*, u.real_name AS manager_name FROM dorm_building db LEFT JOIN user u ON db.manager_id = u.user_id WHERE db.id = #{id}
SELECT db.*, u.real_name AS manager_name FROM dorm_building db LEFT JOIN user u ON db.manager_id = u.user_id WHERE db.code = #{code} LIMIT 1
SELECT db.*, u.real_name AS manager_name FROM dorm_building db LEFT JOIN user u ON db.manager_id = u.user_id WHERE db.name = #{name} LIMIT 1
SELECT db.*, u.real_name AS manager_name FROM dorm_building db LEFT JOIN user u ON db.manager_id = u.user_id WHERE db.manager_id = #{managerId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dorm_building (name, code, campus, floors, rooms_per_floor, capacity_per_room, gender, manager_id) VALUES (#{name}, #{code}, #{campus}, #{floors}, #{roomsPerFloor}, #{capacityPerRoom}, #{gender}, #{managerId})
mapper.update: UPDATE dorm_building SET name = #{name}, code = #{code}, campus = #{campus}, floors = #{floors}, rooms_per_floor = #{roomsPerFloor}, capacity_per_room = #{capacityPerRoom}, gender = #{gender}, manager_id = #{managerId} WHERE id = #{id}
